rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In routes_finance.py, audit_accounting_system was calling get_balance_sheet(workshop_id) without the as_of_date parameter. Since get_balance_sheet uses Query() for parameters, calling it directly without named params caused issues.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed line 3605 from 'await get_balance_sheet(workshop_id)' to 'await get_balance_sheet(workshop_id=workshop_id, as_of_date=None)'
